links.outcome: Change in referrals by demographic subgroup after chatbot self-referral introduction versus matched comparator services
links.effect: Total referrals rose 15% vs 6% in matched services; increases were larger for non-binary (235%), bisexual (30%), and ethnic minority (31%) individuals.
links.quote: Importantly, the tool was particularly effective for minority groups, which included non-binary (235% increase), bisexual (30% increase), and ethnic minority individuals (31% increase).

unlisted_practices: Using a conversational AI self-referral chatbot to widen access to mental health services for minority groups

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world deployment of an AI conversational self-referral tool across 28 NHS services, assessing referral rates and equity across demographic groups without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice variation.
